tools.name: work_submit
tools.description: Persist a new Work (goal, optional task plan) and return a durable receipt promptly with workId, revision, admission state and next actions. The receipt means 'accepted and recorded', NOT 'started' or 'done'; the model turn happens later and counts against the Work budget. Reuse the same idempotencyKey after a lost reply; changed content with the same key is a conflict. Do NOT use to send a follow-up to existing Work (use work_message) or to wait (use work_wait).

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-chosen unique key, 1-128 chars [A-Za-z0-9_.:-]. Same key + same content returns the original receipt.

tools.name: work_message
tools.description: Queue a message for a Work or task. Persisted before acknowledged; reply states QUEUED, DELIVERED, UNKNOWN or REJECTED. Default delivery is a NEW turn at the next safe boundary: a running prompt is never modified. UNKNOWN delivery blocks duplicate delivery. Queueing consumes no model turn; dispatch does. Do NOT use to approve wider authority: answering an input request does not grant scope.
